reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: The ch_have_ungotchar private lbool owns validity of ch_ungotchar, initially false; a nonnegative pushback call sets it only after copying the byte.
owner_creation.invariant: Validity refers to one initialized pushback payload.
limitations: ch_have_ungotchar owns a validity flag rather than a cached byte allocation.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ch_get reads the ch_have_ungotchar flag and copies the payload; neither value keeps the active filestate alive or records the input generation.
aliases_escapes.invariant: Availability does not extend input-state lifetime.
limitations: Validity alone does not identify which input supplied ch_ungotchar.

callback_targets.analysis: The ch_have_ungotchar flag gates data selection, not indirect dispatch; overrun diagnostics call error and can cross display owners before replacement completes.
callback_targets.invariant: A validity bit does not protect diagnostic reentry.
limitations: The direct pushback path has no registered validity callback.

invalidation.analysis: Negative ch_ungetchar input cancels validity and ch_get consumes it once; the ch_have_ungotchar Boolean does not itself invalidate any stale active-file alias.
invalidation.invariant: Cancelling pushback and deleting an ifile are distinct actions.

mutation_commit.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar is set after producer payload write and cleared after consumer cache write; the paired state has no atomic commit.
mutation_commit.invariant: Payload publication relies on normal command sequencing.
limitations: The concern is a mismatched payload/validity/input selection during reentry; no concrete runtime failure is claimed for this Boolean.

release_pair.analysis: Clearing the ch_have_ungotchar bit releases no memory or FD; it only discards a logical pending byte.
release_pair.invariant: Pushback validity owns no external release pair.
limitations: Clearing the flag retires a pending byte logically without allocator release.

error_cleanup.analysis: An already-valid slot reports an overrun but subsequently replaces its payload; callers must not mistake the ch_have_ungotchar bit for a retained error receipt.
error_cleanup.invariant: Availability is not an error-result object.

signals_handoff.analysis: ch_have_ungotchar lacks an input-generation identity or exclusive owner protocol, so validity cannot prove the matching filestate is still selected.
signals_handoff.invariant: The validity pair remains under M0-MEM-001.
limitations: Reviewed as coupled pushback state; this does not assert a newly reproduced reentry or file-switch defect.
